The Brandon Styles VARIETY SHOW is a performance by one man that you won't want to miss! Get ready to be amazed by Brandon's live performance, where he impersonates nearly 60 different famous people, from Frank Sinatra to Justin Bieber. This show is unique because Brandon has added just the right amount of comedy, magic, dancing, ventriloquism, and audience participation to keep you entertained in a fast-paced 70-minute show! 

Don't pass up this opportunity to see the best variety show on the Gulf Coast, just a few miles away from Gulf Shores.

*This show runs every Tuesday and Saturday at 7:00 pm year-round.

The Brandon Styles COMEDY MAGIC SHOW is filled with a variety of magic tricks, both big and small, that will astonish and entertain you. This show is designed to make you laugh and leave you in awe. There are plenty of opportunities for audience participation, and fun props are used to create a lively and enjoyable experience for everyone. Make sure you don't miss Alabama's only magic show!

*This show runs on select Wednesdays & Fridays at 7:00 pm.

Join Brandon Styles as he transports you back in time with a captivating performance that will make you reminisce. With his magical voice, Brandon effortlessly sings songs from the 1950s to the 1970s, representing a variety of iconic artists such as Frank Sinatra, Tony Bennett, Neil Diamond, and Louis Armstrong, among others. It's no wonder this show has been voted as the best date night experience on the Gulf Coast.

*This show runs select Sundays at 3:00 pm.

“AN EXPERIENCE LIKE NOTHING ELSE”
— ATTENDEE
BRANDON STYLES IS BOTH TIMELESS AND TIMELY, A STYLE TO STAND OUT

With a variety of exciting shows to choose from, Brandon Styles' 1-Man Variety Show delivers the perfect blend of impressions, comedy, dance, grand illusions, audience interaction, ventriloquism, and award-winning magic. His Magic Show is an action-packed hour of jaw-dropping tricks and hilarious moments! Take a nostalgic journey with the Trip Down Memory Lane Dinner Show, where you'll relive the hits and vibes of the '50s, '60s, and '70s. Having toured across the country, Brandon Styles brings his unique blend of entertainment to audiences of all ages—whether you're 8 or 80, his shows are sure to captivate and delight!
